name: Suo Kyoya
source:
[i]"Again!? Why do I always get caught up in these things!?"[/i]

Before entering the Japanese branch of the Special Organization Ord, Suo was a soldier of the Air Self-Defense Force's Special Assault Unit. He can operate any aircraft. Suo was originally aiming to become a police officer but was tricked by a talent scout from the army, who involved him in taking the Japanese Self-Defense Forces exam before the police academy exam started, which made him a soldier. Suo is the youngest in his family and is often bullied by his two sisters who have bad personalities.

[From [url=https://velvet-react.com/en/chara002.php]Official Website[/url]]
